title: Density classification performance and ergodicity of the Gacs-Kurdyumov-Levin cellular automaton model IV
summary: Modern analysis of a classic density-classification CA that is useful as a template for conservative support-repair dynamics.

title: Convolution numbers: the cyclic case
summary: Sharpens the circulant Goethals-Seidel route to order 668 into a concrete length-167 binary support obstruction with prescribed convolution data.

title: Regional controllability of cellular automata as a SAT problem
summary: Warns that many CA rules have poor reachability at scale and provides a SAT formulation for controllability checks.
